Stop "vibe coding" and start actual engineering with AI agents. 🚀

Matt Pocock’s new `skills` repository is a game-changer for professional developers who want to leverage AI without losing control over their architecture, code quality, and correctness. 

We’ve all been there: AI coding tools are fast, but they often lead to alignment issues, massive verbosity, and software entropy that turns your clean codebase into an unmaintainable ball of mud. 

`mattpocock/skills` solves this by providing a composable, unopinionated framework of small, model-agnostic agent skills that integrate directly into the tools you already use. 

🔥 Key Features:

• Grilling Sessions (grill-me & grill-with-docs): Forces your AI agent to stop guessing, ask clarifying questions, and establish a shared domain language before writing a single line of code.
• Strict TDD Loops: Enforces disciplined red-green-refactor workflows and phase-by-phase debugging to drastically cut down on hallucinations.
• Architecture Protection: Tools like improve-codebase-architecture survey your project to prevent feature bloat and entropy.
• Cross-Agent Compatibility: Works seamlessly out of the box with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, and Gemini CLI.

Say goodbye to misaligned, overly verbose AI output and hello to disciplined, structured AI-assisted development. 

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/mattpocock/skills

Drop a comment below: Are you sticking to manual coding, or are you upgrading your workflow with structured agent skills? 👇

🚀 Tired of rigid, monolithic AI agent frameworks that make customizing tools feel like major surgery?

DeepSeek just dropped deepseek-harness, an open-source agent harness built around an uncompromising everything-is-a-plugin architecture. 

It completely eliminates tight coupling in AI orchestration. Every core component, tool, and capability functions as an independent, composable plugin, giving you a fully modular and extensible environment.

Key features include:
🔌 Everything-is-a-plugin architecture that isolates features and encourages clean modular extensions
🧠 Powered by Cordis, implementing a novel design rooted in a programming paradigm for spatiotemporal composability
💻 Built-in Web UI accessible instantly via npx or local source builds for immediate interactive agent management
🌱 A rapidly evolving developer preview ecosystem with explicit support for community contributions

Whether you are building and scaling custom multi-agent orchestration systems with hot-swappable tool plugins, or developing proprietary internal tools with tailored Web UI extensions, this harness lets you swap tools, modify memory pipelines, and extend interfaces seamlessly without vendor lock-in.

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

Tired of subscription fees and closed-source silos locking away the tools you use every day? 🛑

Say hello to HeyPuter/everything—an ambitious open-source monorepo aiming to rebuild every major proprietary software tool—from Photoshop to Slack and Excel—from scratch using standard web technologies. 🚀

The problem: Developers and users are too dependent on expensive, closed SaaS ecosystems for essential software. 

The solution: Fully free, open-source, MIT-licensed equivalents running natively in the browser via Node.js 22.12+. 

🔥 Key Features:
• Comprehensive Monorepo Architecture: Dozens of complex desktop-class apps (office suites, creative studios, dev tools, games) under a single codebase.
• Modern Web Tech Stack: Built with modern frameworks running seamlessly in the browser.
• Drop-in Open-Source Alternatives: Functional web-native counterparts to Microsoft Office, Adobe Photoshop, Zoom, Slack, AutoCAD, and more.
• Live Deployment Previews: Test core apps instantly with live instances like spreadsheet.puter.com and meetings.puter.com.

💡 Why Developers Love It:
Study production-grade implementations for canvas rendering, state management, real-time collaboration, and complex UI component design. Fork it to build custom SaaS solutions, or learn advanced frontend architecture by examining how high-performance apps are engineered for the browser.

Explore the code, run it locally, and contribute today:
https://github.com/HeyPuter/everything

Tired of bloated, sluggish web-based design tools that hold your projects hostage in the cloud? 🛠️💨

Meet FigCraft: a clean-room, pure Rust reimplementation of Figma designed for blazing speed, total privacy, and next-gen AI workflows. 

FigCraft eliminates Electron bloat and cloud lock-in by delivering sub-millisecond document manipulation, full offline support, and native control for autonomous AI agents. 

⚡ Key Features:
• Blazing Fast Native Engine: Execute operations on massive 20,000-node files in a fraction of a millisecond with zero web views.
• Local-First & Private: Store files as plain disk archives (.figcraft) with zero required accounts, telemetry, or cloud dependencies.
• Dual-Interface Command Architecture: Access every menu, tool, and canvas interaction via UI, CLI, JSON control channel, or MCP server.
• Full Design Parity: Built-in support for auto layouts, variable-width strokes, live theme collections, vector networks, and real-time collaboration.

Whether you are a systems engineer wanting to escape heavy JavaScript stacks or an AI developer looking to give your agents programmatic control over production-ready user interfaces, FigCraft is built for you. Embed design system generation right into your CI/CD pipelines or build lightning-fast local-first vector editors from scratch. 🚀

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/storytold/figcraft

Clone the repo, drop your feedback in the comments, and star the project to support high-performance native Rust software! ⭐

Deploy your own private, persistent AI assistant entirely on Cloudflare's free tier with a single command. 🚀

Tired of subscription fees, privacy concerns, and the hassle of keeping a traditional server online just to run a personal AI companion? 

Talorys solves this by packing a full chat interface, semantic memory, task manager, and cron-based automations into a serverless architecture running inside a single Cloudflare account. 

✨ Key Features:
• Durable Object SQLite backend for stateful chat history and reliable cron scheduling via alarms—no server required.
• Zero-public-URL private Worker architecture securely connected to Cloudflare Pages via service bindings.
• Optional semantic recall that tracks changing facts over time and handles automatic conflict resolution.
• Built-in cost controls tracking token and neuron consumption against Cloudflare free-tier quotas.

Whether you want a zero-cost personal assistant for daily digests and task management, or you need a production-grade reference architecture for building serverless apps using Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, SQLite, and Hono, Talorys is ready to deploy.

Check out the repository and spin up your edge AI assistant today:
https://github.com/rociiu/talorys
